Around [[1 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] and [[Luke Skywalker]] went on an undercover [[diplomat]]ic '''mission''' to the [[planet]] of [[Tibrin]], on the edge of the [[Hadar sector]]. Posing as diplomats from [[Naboo]]'s [[House Berenko]] seeking to negotiate a trade deal, they aimed to rally the [[Homeworld|native]] [[Ishi Tib]] to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]'s cause.<ref name="Trouble at Tibrin" />

==Prelude==
On the [[planet]] [[Tibrin]], [[Mariod]] [[Govi]] was trying to convince [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] to not go undercover as an [[Imperial officer]] in an [[Mission to Tibrin|attempt to rescue]] [[Luke Skywalker]] from the [[Galactic Empire]]. Organa told Govi that the Empire had injured two of their guests and captured a third and if it wasn't enough to convince the [[Ishi Tib]] [[Kalikeedan]] to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] then she couldn't help them and took off to rescue Skywalker.

On the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|Imperial Star Destroyer]], the ''[[Stormbringer]]'', Skywalker was hooked up to an [[Scan Grid|Imperial torture device]] about to be [[torture]]d for information by [[Captain]] [[Davin Bryce]], who said this was his way to a promotion

==Rescue==
Organa had landed in the [[hangar]] of the ''Stormbringer'' and was halted by two [[stormtrooper]]s while she was checking in. Organa fibbed and told them that she was a transfer from the [[Malevolence (qaz-class)|''Malevolence'']] and was able to get by them as one of the stormtroopers tried to flirt with her. Organa had one of the stormtroopers, [[TK-5648]], walk with her. As they were walking a an elevator one of the other stormtroopers in the hangar realized that her ID was fake but an explosion prevented him from stopping her. Organa had planted a [[thermal detonator]] on her [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|shuttle]] causing the explosion. TK-5648 turned around in response to the explosion and Organa quickly knocked him out. She threw him into the elevator with her, warning his unconscious body to not flirt during his job again. She entered a control room and told everyone there that rebels were in Hangar 14 in order to get them out of the room. After everyone left, she took TK-5648's [[code cylinder]] and used it to chart a path to Skywalker.

Back in the torture room the interrogation machine started to get closer to Skywalker as one of Captain Bryce's [[Imperial officer|officers]] reported that they could not find any rebels onboard the ship. The captain told them to continue the search. Organa was in a [[garbage compactor]] and could here Skywalker's screams through the vents. Bryce asked who [[Skywalker lightsaber|Skywalker's lightsaber]] belonged to, not believing it was his or that he was a [[Jedi]]. Organa reached the room after crawling through the vents and [[stun]]ned the stormtroopers around her and Captain Bryce right before Skywalker was going to be tortured again by the machine.{{Mission-stub}}
